transcript.statement: The performance efficiency of the autonomous driving system is paramount for achieving optimal speed and reducing travel time. My requirements (EFF-01, EFF-02, EFF-05, EFF-06) focus on minimizing travel time, maintaining jerk limits for passenger comfort, and ensuring rapid processing of non-convex constraints. I raise concerns about SAF-02 and RES-06, which prioritize safety and smoothness during emergency maneuvers, potentially compromising overall performance efficiency. Emergency protocols should also consider performance measures, ensuring the system remains responsive under critical conditions.

transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in autonomous driving systems. The EfficiencyAgent's focus on performance may compromise safety, especially during emergencies. Specifically, relaxing the MRM execution time (SAF-02) and jerk limits (RES-06) can lead to unsafe situations and increased risk of accidents. requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture ensuring passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds, ensuring safety while integrating performance optimization and energy efficiency measures.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue a human takeover request when boundaries are approached.
The system shall maintain jerk limits during normal operations and allow temporary relaxation during MRMs with strict safety and data protection measures.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints to prevent rollover during maneuvers at all speeds.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints within a response time of 100 milliseconds.
The system shall ensure compliance with Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions and changes for accountability and regulatory purposes.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: The MRM execution time is maintained at 5 seconds while integrating performance optimization and energy efficiency.
Jerk limits are maintained and allow temporary relaxation during MRMs with strict safety and data protection measures.
